reasons.persona_fit: Accurately targets a 1–10 person business with calm, restrained tone and follows the no-CTA rule, though it slips into first-person singular ('I would separate') instead of Bareni's standard public 'we'.
reasons.clarity: The argument is clear, logically organized, and immediately understandable on first read, clearly distinguishing gut feeling from observable data trails.
reasons.actionability: Provides a realistic, bounded manual audit step (reviewing one month of lapses and touchpoints) to decide whether automation is viable before building anything.
reasons.factual_grounding: Makes no fabricated claims or promises; accurately notes that AI requires pre-existing digital records and leaves the decision to the human owner.
